widgets_values: Image 2 shows an oil painting in a gold frame on a museum wall. Image 1 is a photo of the person in the painting. Edit image 2: the person has come to life and is climbing out of the painting. Their whole upper body is out of the frame, in front of the gold frame and the green wall below it: their head, shoulders and chest are well out in front of the frame, one forearm resting on the bottom rail and the other hand reaching toward the camera with the elbow bent, the arm a natural length, their face large and close to the camera with a gentle smile. They are now a real, photorealistic person: exactly the person in image 1, with the same age, skin, facial hair, hairline and eyes as image 1. Real skin, real hair, real fabric, still wearing exactly the costume from the painting, now as real fabric: the blue and yellow turban, the pearl earring and a loose, collarless 17th-century ochre silk jacket with a wide, flat white linen collar and no lapels or buttons. Bright, soft, even front light with no shadows on the wall: the wall below the frame is evenly lit and clean. The empty dark painted background stays inside the frame behind them. Same wall, same frame in the same place, same camera.

widgets_values: The oil painting in the gold frame comes alive. The painted person slowly turns to face the viewer with a warm smile and leans a little forward. About this workflow
widgets_values:
# Out of the Frame

You, painted Vermeer-style into a gold frame on a museum wall. Then the painting comes alive, grabs the frame and leans out of it, real, reaching for the camera.

FreeField preset `out-of-the-frame`. Runs on a 24 GB GPU (studio profile: Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B). Open weights only.

## Fill in
- A clear photo of your face: the node **Your photo (preset input)**

## Stages, left to right
- Inputs and preset assets
- FLUX.2 klein 4B (all stills)
- 1a\. You, photographed in the costume
- 1b\. Repaint it in oil
- 2\. START: hang it in the frame
- 3\. GRIP: painted hands on the rail
- 4\. OUT: you, real, out of the frame
- 5\. Camera path (crops of the keyframes)
- Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B + lightx2v 4-step (studio profile)
- 6\. Shot 1: the painting comes alive
- 7\. Shot 2: out of the frame
- 8\. Shot 3: the second beat
- 9\. Assemble, save, proof strip

## Models
- `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors`
- `qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors`
- `flux2-vae.safetensors`
- `umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors`
- `wan_2.1_vae.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_high_noise.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_low_noise.safetensors`

## What happens
This graph makes the finished video.
In the FreeField app the START, GRIP and OUT stills are checked before the video (`freefield/gate.py`) and a bad one is re-rolled; in ComfyUI the graph runs once with the seed shown.

## Run it
1. Install this workflow's files into ComfyUI's input folder: `python3 scripts/install_workflow_assets.py --url http://127.0.0.1:8188 out-of-the-frame`
2. Pick your file in the input node above and press Run.

Or run the whole effect in FreeField: `python -m freefield run out-of-the-frame --photo me.jpg`

License: apache-2.0 weights; painting public domain (Wikimedia Commons); plate generated with FLUX.2 klein (no people)
